profile_text.body:
Character.AI, founded in 2022, operates an AI chat application where users can converse with AI characters. The company describes itself as offering "AI Chat, Reimagined" and positions the platform as a place to "chat with millions of AI Characters on the #1 AI chat app."

The company's primary product is Character.ai, a persona-based chat application that uses large language models. According to the held facts, the product carries notes regarding human resources and appropriate-use risk considerations.
